DK27.2 is an ICD-10-DK diagnosis code representing acute gastroduodenal ulcer with both hemorrhage and perforation. In the context of the Danish healthcare system's clinical quality development, this specific code is utilized as part of a broader diagnostic framework to track severe bleeding incidents.

Specifically, DK27.2 is one of the many diagnostic codes used to calculate the incidence of severe bleeding among patients with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. The quality indicators for atrial fibrillation treatment, as outlined by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), rely on a wide array of ICD-10-DK codes to capture different types of bleeding complications [^src1]. For gastrointestinal bleeding, the tracking encompasses codes ranging from [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] to [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]], as well as [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] to [[dk92-2|DK92.2]], with DK27.2 falling within this gastrointestinal category [^src1]. Other categories in this severe bleeding indicator include intracranial bleeding (e.g., [[di60|DI60]] to [[ds066|DS066]]) and urinary/respiratory bleeding (e.g., [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1].

The use of DK27.2 is documented in the annual methodology reports for atrial fibrillation in Denmark, appearing in both the 2023 and 2024 publications as a defined component of the clinical quality indicators [^src1] [^src2]. These reports serve as technical references for standardized data collection, ensuring that severe adverse events like a perforated and bleeding gastroduodenal ulcer are systematically recorded and compared across Danish regions.
